points.description: States that the data rate (of the compressed output) must not exceed the channel capacity (the link's capacity or bandwidth limit).
points.partial_credit: Mentions channel capacity or bandwidth as a constraint without saying the data rate must stay within it.

points.description: States that the full capacity of the communication channel should be used (channel utilised fully, not wasted).
points.partial_credit: Mentions efficient use of the channel or bandwidth in vague terms.

points.description: States that maximum (or high) quality of the data should be preserved after compression.
points.partial_credit: Mentions keeping data quality or minimising loss without saying it should be maximised.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for a student who gives the central idea of the three required items: the data rate must stay within channel capacity, the channel should be used to its full capacity, and the quality should be kept as high as possible; wording may be informal. Award 1 for a student who gets the channel-capacity idea, or two of the three ideas in some form, or states the ideas only halfway. Award 0 for answers about unrelated compression features (e.g. algorithm names, error correction alone) or that contradict the model answer.
